title: NxN E-valuation: Hypothesis Certification via a Conformal CRT Null
author: arXiv cs.AI
summary: The paper introduces NxN E-valuation, a framework for statistically rigorous hypothesis testing in AI evaluation. It leverages conformal prediction and conditional randomization tests (CRT) to certify evaluation claims under a null hypothesis, providing formal guarantees on model comparisons and benchmarking reliability.
